messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — quick question about toolcall resume semantics for streaming. If a client disconnects mid-functioncall stream and reconnects with the same convo ID, do we attempt to resume the function stream or should clients always re-invoke the function? cc @Kevin
Kevin: Short answer: we don't have an automatic resume for in-flight function execution today. reconnect -> client should re-call. but we could expose a resume opt-in if infra supports idempotent execution.
Maria: Is there a defined contract for partial func payloads in the streaming deltas? I'm worried about clients assuming the sequence numbers are contiguous after reconnect.
Kevin: Good point. Current contract: sequence numbers are per-connection. reconnect resets delta seq. We rely on function-level ids for reassembly. so clients must send function_id to dedupe/merge if they want to stitch.
Alice: That implies we should doc the behavior clearly. Suggest adding an explicit field to the stream: `resumeable: boolean` and `func_id` stable across reconnects when backend can resume. If resumeable=false clients must treat midstream as aborted.
Jordan: Example event shape proposal (for discussion):
```json
{"type":"delta","event":"func_chunk","func_id":"fn-123","seq":3,"content":"..."}
{"type":"delta","event":"func_end","func_id":"fn-123","final":true}
```
Kevin: Looks OK. Two important infra constraints: 1) we can guarantee stable func_id only when the function is started by the hosted runtime (not when proxied to customer infra). 2) resume requires persisted KV of last-seen seq and partial payloads — adds cost.
Maria: For backwards compatibility: clients that expect `seq` to be global will break. We should mark `seq` as connection-scoped in the schema docs and add `global_offset` only when resume supported.
Jordan: Suggested compatibility migration text: "seq is connection-scoped; to support reconnect+stitching, use func_id + global_offset (optional) when provided by server."
Alice: Ops ask: can we add a feature flag `toolcall_resume` under per-customer config so we can opt-in enterprise accounts while keeping default behaviour stable?
Kevin: Yes, we can gate it. Implementation plan: flag toggles 1) server persists func_id+chunks to durable store for N minutes, 2) stream adds `resumeable:true` and `global_offset` metadata, 3) SDK update to attempt resume if server advertises resumeable.
Maria: Punting questions for design doc: how long to retain partial chunks? default 5 minutes? we should allow config.
Alice: I'll draft a short doc and PR for the schema changes + migration note. assigning to @Kevin for infra feasibility check.
Kevin: I'll run numbers and post ops impact by EOD.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout note: api:toolcall-streaming will be deployed to canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Will include feature-flag scaffolding only (no persisting enabled). :eyes:
Jordan: Thanks everyone. If Kevin says OK, I'll add a compat test and a small client example showing dedupe with func_id.
Alice: tiny nit — add a small JSON sample for clients showing reconnect flow in the doc.
Kevin: Added to my checklist.
Maria: SGTM.
Jordan: Closing here for now — follow-ups in the design doc thread. :thumbsup:
